newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil's Yme oilfield output stabilises.
newsitem.headline: Statoil's Yme oilfield output stabilises.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday operations at the North Sea Yme development returned to normal following improvements to the gas plant on the Maersk Giant production platform last October.
"We achieved good plant availability with the gas compressors since December," production manager Leif Arne Hoeyland told the company's Status Weekly newsletter.
The compressors reinject produced gas into the reservoir.
Gas output had to be flared while the compressors were off line and, due to regulations governing the amount of gas permitted to be burned off at Yme, oil production at the field had to be reduced.
Statoil said target output at Yme in 1997 was 37,000 barrels per day (bpd). The field currently pumps 33,000 bpd due to maintenance at one production well.
Maxiumum processing capacity on Maersk Giant is 50,000 bpd.
